description: A live ticking countdown to your wedding day: days, hours, minutes and seconds updating every second, plus weeks and the weekday.

faqs.a: Yes — it ticks every second while the page is open, showing days, hours, minutes and seconds remaining.

faqs.q: Can I include the ceremony time?
faqs.a: Yes, add the time of day for a precise countdown; otherwise it counts down to midnight at the start of the date.

faqs.q: What if the wedding already happened?
faqs.a: The tool switches to celebration mode and shows how long you have been married instead.

howto: Watch the live countdown tick in days, hours, minutes and seconds.
Share the tab on a screen at the engagement party.
title: Wedding Countdown
